questions.question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.

Helium is used with oxygen for asthma treatment because it __________ very easily.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**diffuses**'.

__
 
• The word "**diffuses**" means to spread or cause to spread over a wide area or among a large number of people.
 
• Helium is used with oxygen for asthma treatment because it diffuses very easily.
 
• The other options: "**diffusez**," "**difuses**," and "**diffuzes**" are not correctly spelled.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Helium is used with oxygen for asthma treatment because it diffuses__ very easily.*

• **Difuses**: Incorrect spelling, should be "diffuses".
 
• **Diffuzes**: Incorrect spelling, does not convey the intended meaning.

questions.question: Select the sentence in which the ‘-ing’ form of verb expresses the continuity of an action/event.

options.text: Reading novels is my favourite pastime.
I am fond of reading science fiction.
Please do not disturb me. I am preparing for exams.
The optician advised me to use reading glasses.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the third part of the given sentence, the continuous form of the verb 'preparing' is used correctly.
 
• The sentence "I am preparing for exams" uses the **continuous form** of the verb to indicate an ongoing action.
 
• Therefore, the -ing form in this context represents the continuity of an action.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *Please do not disturb me. I am **preparing** for exams*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **continuous form** of verbs, also known as the **progressive form**, is used to indicate actions that are ongoing at the moment of speaking.
 
• It is formed using the verb 'to be' in the appropriate tense followed by the -ing form of the main verb.
 
 
• **Example:** *I am **reading** a book right now.*

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Dipesh will send Rakesh away to college for certain reasons.

options.text: Rakesh will have to be sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh.
Rakesh will be sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh.
Rakesh would have been sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh.
Rakesh would be sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Dipesh will send Rakesh away to college for certain reasons."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "Rakesh" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will send" to "will be sent" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Dipesh."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Rakesh will be sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Rakesh will have to be sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh." – Incorrect tense (future necessity passive).
 
• **Option 3:** "Rakesh would have been sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh." – Incorrect tense (past conditional passive).
 
• **Option 4:** "Rakesh would be sent away to college for certain reasons by Dipesh." – Incorrect tense (conditional passive).

questions.question:

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Sivamani __is working__ as an electrician for the past 22 years.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence uses the present continuous tense ("is working") incorrectly for an action that has been ongoing for a long period.
 
• For actions that started in the past and are still continuing in the present, the present perfect continuous tense ("has been working") is used.
 
• The phrase "for the past 22 years" indicates the duration of the action, supporting the use of present perfect continuous tense.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Sivamani has been working as an electrician for the past 22 years."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "had been worked" – Incorrect tense and voice (past perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3:** "have been working" – Incorrect subject-verb agreement as "Sivamani" is singular, and "have" is plural.
 
• **Option 4:** "would work" – Incorrect tense and meaning (future conditional).
